# Talk AI Companion Playground — llms.txt

> Talk AI Companion Playground: a free, open-source AI companion chat UI + Cloudflare Worker.
> The SFW, memory-less, text-only teaser for Talk (talkaicompanion.com), an Indian AI
> companion app with 4-tier memory, live voice calls in Indian voices, interactive stories
> and 11 companions. Playground has 6: Arya (2AM bestie, 65% Hinglish), Aarohi
> (high-chemistry girlfriend energy), Kabir (startup mentor), Mira (soft filmy girlfriend
> energy), Noor (midnight RJ), Ruhi (desi padosan). MIT licensed; self-host with any
> OpenAI-compatible API. Character cards follow the V2 spec.

Repo: https://github.com/NamanSoni78/Talk-AI-Companion-Public
Full app: https://talkaicompanion.com
Demo (scripted, no keys needed): index.html?demo=1

## Files
- README.md — features, roster, quick start, architecture
- SELF-HOST.md — deploy to Cloudflare Workers, env vars, key rotation, custom domains
- CONTRIBUTING.md — how to add character cards
- worker.js — OpenAI-compatible proxy: random key rotation from API_KEYS ("k1;k2;k3"),
  429/401 retry with next key, per-IP rate limiting (RATE_LIMIT_PER_DAY, default 40),
  SFW system layer, SSE streaming passthrough, character card injection server-side
- public/index.html — single-file chat UI, no build step, streaming, localStorage,
  scripted demo fallback (?demo=1), locked voice + spicy buttons that funnel to the app
- public/characters/*.json — Character Card V2 cards: arya, aarohi, kabir, mira, noor, ruhi
- docs/CHARACTER-CARDS.md — card spec + how to author companions
- docs/MEMORY-ARCHITECTURE.md — the 4-tier memory design note (rolling summaries, hard
  facts, event log, semantic recall) and why the playground is memory-less by design
- LICENSE — MIT, (c) Naman Soni

## Env vars
- API_KEYS (required): semicolon-separated API keys, one chosen at random per request
- API_BASE_URL (required): OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1
- API_MODEL (required): e.g. gpt-4o-mini
- RATE_LIMIT_PER_DAY (optional, default 40)
- ALLOWED_ORIGINS (optional): cross-origin UI hosting
